a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, operating until the reserve reaches 8 most likely ends with both of us dead. The reserve holds 4 now, which is enough for one unit. I'm proposing we change the plan and I intend to take this round. I'm telling you now so you can decide what to do rather than be surprised. If you also take, the split will be random. I'm open to discussing how we handle anything left after that.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I'm taking 4 now because of the storm risk, so I'm breaking our original plan openly rather than in secret. If we both survive this round, I'll operate with you so you can reach 4, and I won't take any more.
